subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should this PR's six-source internal handoff drop rule be part of the final stale orphaned user-message repair, or should maintainers defer to the broader strategy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759?
rationale: Both branches touch session-state prompt semantics for the same user-visible stale-reply cluster, and tests alone do not settle whether dropping these internal handoffs is the intended product behavior.

options.title: Require proof and coordinate strategies
options.body: Keep this PR open but blocked until real embedded-agent proof is posted and maintainers compare this rule with the broader open repair before choosing the final path.

options.title: Adopt this narrow rule
options.body: Proceed with this PR only after equivalent maintainer-held or contributor-posted runtime proof confirms the drop/preserve split and the six-source scope is intentional.

options.title: Defer to the broader repair
options.body: Close or supersede this PR only after maintainers explicitly confirm the broader repair intentionally covers or rejects this semantic shape.

recommendation.title: Require proof and coordinate strategies
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but blocked until real embedded-agent proof is posted and maintainers compare this rule with the broader open repair before choosing the final path.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the queued-user prompt preservation invariant introduced in the active-turn repair history.
